# CineTrack — Cinema Tracker & Movie Discovery

> CineTrack is a modern, high-performance web application designed for movie enthusiasts to discover trending titles, track personal watchlists, rate films, and curate custom movie collections.

## Core Capabilities
- **Featured Spotlight Carousel**: Top-5 trending movies of the week with interactive auto-advancing hero banner.
- **Real-Time Movie Discovery**: Search and discover movies powered by TMDB metadata, posters, backdrops, and trailers.
- **Personal Watchlist & Library**: Track status ("Plan to Watch", "Watching", "Completed"), assign 1-10 star ratings, and write personal reviews.
- **Custom Collections**: Create and organize custom thematic lists of movies.
- **Multi-User Sync & Offline Guest Support**: Cloud synchronization via Supabase Auth & PostgreSQL, with local storage fallback for instant guest access.
- **Paginated & Infinite Scroll Catalog**: Browse endless catalogs for Trending, Popular, Action, Comedy, Romance, Sci-Fi, Horror, Drama, and Animation.

## Key Routes & Sitemap
- `/`: Featured Spotlight Carousel, Trending This Week, Fan Favorites, Comedy, Romance, Action, Sci-Fi.
- `/search`: Real-time movie search engine with genre filter pills and sorting options.
- `/library`: Personal movie watchlist & rating library with filtering and sorting controls.
- `/collections`: User-created custom movie collections.
- `/genre/trending`: Infinite scroll catalog of trending movies.
- `/genre/popular`: Infinite scroll catalog of popular blockbusters.
- `/genre/35`: Infinite scroll catalog of comedy films.
- `/genre/10749`: Infinite scroll catalog of romantic films.
- `/genre/28`: Infinite scroll catalog of action films.
- `/genre/878`: Infinite scroll catalog of sci-fi films.
- `/genre/27`: Infinite scroll catalog of horror films.
- `/genre/18`: Infinite scroll catalog of drama films.
- `/genre/16`: Infinite scroll catalog of animated films.
